title: Latency p95 and error rate from the access log
prompt:
For the SLO dashboard, implement `summarize(lines)` in app/slo.py. Each line of the access log looks like
`2026-11-20T10:00:01Z GET /api/orders 200 123ms`. Return a dict keyed by path with `{"requests": n, "p95_ms": int,
"error_rate": float}`: p95 uses the nearest-rank method (the value at position ceil(0.95*n) of the sorted latencies),
`error_rate` is the share of 5xx responses rounded to 4 decimals. Lines that do not match the format are skipped.
